description: Source code for iOS exception minidump generator in the Google Breakpad project, handling crash context and thread state for iOS.

classes.name: IosExceptionMinidumpGenerator
classes.description: Class responsible for generating minidumps for iOS exceptions, including crash context and thread info.

methods.name: WriteCrashingContext
methods.description: Writes the crash context for the thread, delegating to architecture-specific methods.

methods.name: GetPCFromException
methods.description: Retrieves the program counter from the exception's return addresses.

methods.name: GetLRFromException
methods.description: Retrieves the link register from the exception's return addresses.

methods.name: WriteExceptionStream
methods.description: Writes exception information into the minidump.

methods.name: WriteThreadStream
methods.description: Writes thread state, including stack frames, into the minidump.
